l: A person must register with the board before beginning a board-approved internship in this state.
An application for registration as a pharmacist-intern must be on a form prescribed by the board.
A person's registration as a pharmacist-intern remains in effect as long as the person meets the qualifications for an internship specified by board rule.
(1) refuse to issue a registration to an applicant; or
(2) restrict, suspend, or revoke a pharmacist-intern registration for a violation of this subtitle.

(b) The board may take disciplinary action against an applicant for a pharmacist-intern registration or the holder of a current or expired pharmacist-intern registration in the same manner as against an applicant for a license or a license holder by imposing a sanction authorized under Section 565.051 if the board finds that the applicant or registration holder has engaged in conduct described by Section 565.001.
